correctness.rationale: For open ladder P_n×K_2 and prism C_n×K_2 with all edges unit segments, endpoint-route distance kernels partition rail–rail, rail–rung and rung–rung pairs. Integrating Z=min(u+v,2−u−v) with density 2z and same-cell corrections gives explicit conditional moment tables; arclength weights 4(n−1)^2:4n(n−1):n² for open and 4:4:1 for circular yield each displayed rational/parity formula. The strict mean difference reduces to Q(n)=81t^4+648t³+1842t²+2128t+725>0, t=n−3. Coupled horizontal coordinates differ by at most 1/n per point and vertical detours at most two, establishing error ≤4/n and different triangular versus uniform circle limits, mean ratio 3/4 and variance ratio 3/8. Fresh independent numerical endpoint-route quadrature for n=3..6 matched analytic means and second moments within 5.1e−5; analytic proof covers all n.
